_order: environment -> code -> data -> scores -> figures. Paths are relative to the repository root; the manifest holds no absolute path.
_note_prereg: There is no pre-registration stage: the repository ships a closed-form model, a known-answer simulation of it and the arithmetic of a published table, not a pre-registered experiment.
_note_code: Test files are listed by name on purpose: files owned by other documents of the repository (docs/THEORY.md and tests/test_doc_numbers.py, which locks the numbers quoted in README.md) are not part of the computational chain and may change without breaking the seal.
_note_replicated: run_all.py writes regenerated outputs to output/replicated/; that directory matches no glob below (tests/test_stages_disjoint.py). Only run_all.py --publish writes the sealed outputs.
